about: Published broker margin figures for hedged NIFTY option spreads, copied by hand from the pages below on 2026-11-01 (no personal data). spot_close is NIFTY 50's close the session before the article, from history-^NSEI-1d.json in this folder; NSE charges exposure on the underlying's last close. days is calendar days from the article to the expiry.

examples.source: HDFC Securities (Nandish Shah) via Business Standard, 09-Jan-2026: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/f-o-trade-analyst-suggests-bear-spread-on-nifty-for-jan-9-check-levels-126010900086_1.html

HDFC Securities (Nandish Shah) via Business Standard, 13-Mar-2026: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/f-o-trade-analyst-suggests-bear-spread-on-nifty-for-march-30-check-levels-126031300089_1.html
HDFC Securities (Nandish Shah) via Business Standard, 24-Apr-2026: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/analyst-suggests-bear-bull-spreads-on-nifty-au-sfb-check-strategy-126042400100_1.html
Zerodha Z-Connect, 'New margin framework for F&O trades' (June 2020): https://zerodha.com/z-connect/general/new-margin-framework-for-fo-trades

published.words: SPAN Rs. 7,437, Exposure Rs. 14,370, Total Rs. 21,808 (bear call spread, 1 lot of 75)

examples.note: Only the split is used: exposure = 2% of the notional of the ONE short leg (14,370 / 75 / 0.02 = NIFTY 9,580), and SPAN about the spread's width x qty (100 x 75 = 7,500): SPAN less the net option value, hedge counted. Old lot size and pre-2024 rates.

rules.rule: ELM is charged on every short option, hedged or not; no offset for long options
rules.source: NSE equity derivatives margins page: https://www.nseindia.com/static/products-services/equity-derivatives-margins ('As no extreme loss margin is levied on long positions there cannot be any offset provided')

rules.rule: Index ELM 2% of notional; 3% when a short index option is over 10% out of the money; 5% over 9 months; stocks 3.5%, 5.25% over 30% out of the money; notional on the underlying's last close
Total SPAN = SPAN risk less the net option value; index price scan at least 9.3% (17.7% over 9 months), stocks at least 14.2%; no calendar benefit on expiry day for the expiring index contracts
Additional 2% ELM on short index options on their expiry day, from 20-Nov-2024
rules.source: SEBI circular SEBI/HO/MRD/TPD-1/P/CIR/2024/132 of 01-Oct-2024; a broker confirms it applies 'irrespective of whether the position is hedged' (Zerodha, tradingqna.com/t/margin-requirements-for-hedged-trades-up-by-80/176129)
